blocks.text: A gene is a specific sequence of nucleotides along a DNA strand that directs the synthesis of a polypeptide (protein). In other words, a gene expresses itself by making a protein or an enzyme that controls the development of a particular trait. All organisms use the same basic mechanism to express their genes.

blocks.explanation: By directing the making of a protein or enzyme, which then controls the development of a trait.

items: Gene expression: a gene's nucleotide sequence is used to make a polypeptide.
